g.data-label: 01 Normal persistence reference: an interruption executes only the prefix ending at A/B/C/D. Without interruption, continue directly to the next round and skip recovery below.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 01 Normal persistence reference: an interruption executes only the prefix ending at A/B/C/D. Without interruption, continue directly to the next round and skip recovery below.

g.data-label: A: waiting for inference or T1 not committed. This action has no durable dispatch intent and must not have entered Driver.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: A: waiting for inference or T1 not committed. This action has no durable dispatch intent and must not have

g.data-label: B: T1 committed, T2 absent. Dispatch may be unstarted, running, or finished without a saved receipt; never retry on intent alone.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: B: T1 committed, T2 absent. Dispatch may be unstarted, running, or finished without a saved receipt; never

g.data-label: C: T2 saved, T3 absent. Execution facts are known, but post-observation or the complete step may be unfinished.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: C: T2 saved, T3 absent. Execution facts are known, but post-observation or the complete step may be

g.data-label: D: T3 committed. The full step and settlement are durable; do not repeat execution or accounting.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: D: T3 committed. The full step and settlement are durable; do not

g.data-label: 02 Interrupted tasks only. H is a logical lifeline: old execution handles cleanup, then takeover installs a new owner. Old execution cannot advance after takeover.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 02 Interrupted tasks only. H is a logical lifeline: old execution handles cleanup, then takeover installs a new owner. Old execution cannot advance after takeover.

g.data-label: Handlers/finalizers may never run. Use earlier durable data, journal and bodies; never assume a final save.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Handlers/finalizers may never run. Use earlier durable data, journal and bodies; never assume a final save.

g.data-label: 03 Entry: the scanner skips live running handles. safe_auto may enter automatically, manual needs an explicit request, disabled never continues.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 03 Entry: the scanner skips live running handles. safe_auto may enter automatically, manual needs an

g.data-label: Missing device: waiting_for_device. Wait expired or identity mismatch: recovery_blocked. Return from this recovery attempt here.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Missing device: waiting_for_device. Wait expired or identity mismatch: recovery_blocked. Return from this

g.data-label: Without quiescence proof, retain quarantine, record recovery_blocked and return. Only successful isolation permits reconciliation.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Without quiescence proof, retain quarantine, record recovery_blocked and return. Only successful

g.data-label: Verify state and required bodies. Unrecoverable bodies: failed; other repairable structural errors: blocked. Return now, with bounded rechecks only after repair.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Verify state and required bodies. Unrecoverable bodies: failed; other repairable structural errors:
blocked. Return now, with bounded rechecks only after repair.

g.data-label: 04 Reconcile by cut point: A/B/C/D below are alternatives matching 01. Pixels do not establish historical execution.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 04 Reconcile by cut point: A/B/C/D below are alternatives matching 01. Pixels do not establish historical

g.data-label: 05 Restore original role, plan, notes, prompts, dialogue and skills. Reconnect read tools and clear stale grounding.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 05 Restore original role, plan, notes, prompts, dialogue and skills. Reconnect read tools and clear stale

g.data-label: Late old-model replies cannot advance the new owner. Retain recorded requests/consumption and cumulative budgets.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Late old-model replies cannot advance the new owner. Retain recorded requests/consumption and cumulative

g.data-label: Rejoin the normal chain: Driver execution, T2 receipt, post-observation, T3 full commit. Never replay the old operation ID.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Rejoin the normal chain: Driver execution, T2 receipt, post-observation, T3 full commit. Never replay the old operation ID.
